title: Price Bands, Movement Limits and Delivery Limits: Keyturn Vehicle Listing Class Tariff
content:
Each Keyturn Vehicle Listing class publishes the band its daily price sits in, how far that price may move in a day, how long it is locked afterwards, the lowest whole trip price the class accepts, and how far the vehicle may be delivered. The monthly fee for keeping the listing live and the fee for featuring it in search results are carried on the same tariff.

| Class | Daily price floor (USD) | Daily price ceiling (USD) | Most the daily price may move in one day (per cent) | Lockout after a change (hours) | Lowest whole trip price (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | 22.00 | 95.00 | 25 | 12 | 22.00 |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | 38.00 | 165.00 | 25 | 12 | 38.00 |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | 75.00 | 320.00 | 20 | 24 | 75.00 |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | 165.00 | 750.00 | 15 | 24 | 165.00 |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | 450.00 | 2800.00 | 10 | 48 | 450.00 |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | 85.00 | 425.00 | 20 | 24 | 85.00 |

| Class | Furthest delivery from the home city (miles) | Handover at an airport | Monthly listing fee (USD) | Featured placement fee (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | 15 | not offered | 0.00 | 19.00 |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | 25 | offered | 0.00 | 29.00 |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | 40 | offered | 0.00 | 45.00 |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | 60 | offered | 19.00 | 79.00 |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | 100 | offered | 49.00 | 195.00 |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | 50 | not offered | 29.00 | 59.00 |

In every class the lowest whole trip price stands at the same figure as the daily price floor. A monthly figure of 0.00 USD means the class charges nothing for keeping the listing live; the featured placement fee is charged in every class.
